title: Python: Advanced Comprehensions
description: Write a Python program that uses nested list/dict/set comprehensions with conditions.

codeTemplate.py:
matrix = [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6], [7, 8, 9]]

flattened = [x for row in matrix for x in row]
print(f"Flattened: {flattened}")

transposed = [[row[i] for row in matrix] for i in range(3)]
print(f"Transposed: {transposed}")

even_squares = {x: x**2 for x in range(1, 11) if x % 2 == 0}
print(f"Even squares dict: {even_squares}")

vowels = {c for word in ['hello', 'world', 'python'] for c in word if c in 'aeiou'}
print(f"Vowels set: {sorted(vowels)}")

cartesian = [(x, y) for x in range(3) for y in range(3) if x != y]
print(f"Cartesian (x!=y): {cartesian[:6]}...")

hints: Nested comprehensions: `[expr for a in A for b in B]`
Dict comprehensions: `{key: value for item in iterable}`
Set comprehensions: `{expr for item in iterable}`
Multiple `for` clauses are evaluated left to right
